response.sql:
WITH playlist_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    PlaylistId,
    COUNT(*) as track_count
  FROM PlaylistTrack
  GROUP BY PlaylistId
),
average_calculation AS (
  SELECT AVG(track_count) as avg_count
  FROM playlist_counts
)
SELECT 
  pc.PlaylistId,
  pc.track_count,
  pc.track_count / ac.avg_count as ratio
FROM playlist_counts pc
CROSS JOIN average_calculation ac
ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average is calculated across all playlists that have at least one track entry (determined by the GROUP BY in the CTE), not just the final 10 returned.
The ratio is computed as floating-point division without rounding, leaving precision as returned by the database engine.
NULLS LAST is supported by the target SQL dialect; if not, ORDER BY ratio DESC, ratio IS NULL ASC will achieve the same effect.
